styleGoal: Warm softly lit cartoon honey-wood stool consistent with selected reskin; real native 3D with original identity and palette family.
immutableTechnicalConstraints: Preserve square-grid camera/projection, framing and pixel aspect, logical frame 192x352, physical frame 384x704, logical root (96,248), sourceScale 2 and one-cell footprint.
Preserve native size, height/proportions, root, seat/occupant_ground sockets, support contact and three-board backless seat identity. Do not adopt target widening, padding or shape drift.

Deliver static N/E/S/W captures from independent native geometry views under one consistent scene setup, 1 frame per facing, 12 fps metadata and nonlooping static contract. No per-view fitting, recoloring, target card or image warp.
Use horizontally neutral soft lighting without a preferred horizontal direction and no directional ground cast shadow. Preserve genuine transparent sprite output.
Keep editable native source and evidence for capture transforms, geometry bounds, socket positions and declared resources.

shapeVolume: The thin square honey-wood seat, clipped/softened corners, three boards, splayed supports and stretcher remain identifiable at intended size.
Seat rim and support edges have gentle readable volume rather than abrupt faceted bands; softening stays within the source envelope and seat height.
color: Maintain honey-yellow/golden-orange seat and warm brown legs/stretcher.
Seat retains tonal room for highlights, midtones and edge shading without flattening to one bright yellow patch; lower supports retain brown/orange information rather than becoming black or gray.
lightingHighlights: Broad subdued highlights and gradual transitions convey warm matte/satin cartoon wood.
Equivalent sides have coherent light treatment across N/E/S/W; no unilateral shiny stripe, bright burned outline or directional ground shadow.
Underside/joins can be darker but remain legible without large dead-black regions.
materialDetail: Two board seams read as gentle inset separations rather than harsh painted stripes or deep black slits.
Any grain or color variation is restrained and follows the wood surface; no noisy texture or uniform plastic glare is required.
Leg/stretcher joins remain clean and distinct; smooth surface shading does not smear the structure.
artifactFreeReadability: All four facings are clean at logical use size and enlarged: no halos, isolated pixels, alpha fringes, broken corners, seams, coplanar overlap artifacts, clipped edges or floating supports.
Four-view sheet and repeated preview use identical scale/registration and show a coherent stool without per-view fitting.
Seat and supports remain distinct on neutral light, gray and dark backgrounds; soft lighting must not erase the board layout or merge the legs.

rankedPriorities.criterion: Soft golden seat volume and restrained broad highlights, retaining source dimensions and board structure.
Warm readable lower support volumes with clean joins and no dead-black patches.
Subtle inset seams, clean alpha, and consistent native four-facing appearance under horizontally neutral light.

targetConflictsAndLimits: Target silhouette rounding, apparent enlargement, registration drift and stray outline pixels must not be copied.
The single-view target establishes material/light vocabulary; unseen facings must be coherent native views, not invented target matches.
Exact target texture/grain and photographic pixel identity are not required; visible improvement toward soft warm wood must be material, not merely a hue change.
approvalEvidence: Hash-bound packet including native editable project, all four required PNGs, four-view-sheet and repeated previews, and technical validation.
Judge inspects exact hash-matching candidate pixels and confirms registration/sockets/size/lighting from native evidence; a rendered file alone is insufficient.
